_provenance.method: isolated CODEX_HOME with its own hooks.json declaring a Stop hook that dumped stdin verbatim; codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust -s read-only
_provenance.why_bypass_trust: a fresh CODEX_HOME has no persisted hooks.state and Codex SILENTLY skips untrusted hooks; that silent skip is indistinguishable from 'no Stop event exists' and is how manifest.json came to assert Codex had none
_provenance.block_contract_verified: returning {"decision": "block", "reason": ...} produced 'hook: Stop Blocked', the agent continued and obeyed the reason, and the re-entered Stop arrived with stop_hook_active=true
